articles.title: Military exercise to take place in Galilee and Be'er Sheva area
articles.description: The IDF Spokesperson's Unit announced that a military exercise will begin on Monday in the Galilee region in northern Israel and several areas near Be'er Sheva in the south. The exercise is expected to conclude Wednesday evening. Increased movement of security forces and vehicles is expected during the exercise. The IDF emphasized that there is no security threat.
